items.title: Outcome of three years of regional confrontation: The emergence of new alliances
items.summary: LONDON -- The outcome of the confrontations that have taken place across the West Asia region since October 7 must be understood in the context of all the interconnected fronts, including Gaza, Lebanon, and, most recently, Iran. items.title: France sees biggest day of protests in years

items.title: Syria aids Saudi Arabia with military advice and training amid Houthi attacks, sources say
